config.kernel: Gaussian bandwidth=distance to 10th visible distinct parent (adaptive, past only)
config.regression: StandardScaler + LogisticRegression(C=1), refit every 10 prior Refine attempts
config.neighborhood: Previously selected Refine parents only; excludes current parent; all prior attempts retained
config.prediction: per-run expanding prequential; no cross-run fitting, no outcome-based hyperparameter search
config.behavior_protocol: v3 full 4 probes/panel; OP B synthetic training seed 20260907; CVRP B train indices 4..7; no val/test
config.primary: paired per-run Brier delta M3-M1; log loss corroboration; report tasks/backend separately
config.go_gate: screening only: macro Brier relative reduction >=2%, direction improves >=3/5 tasks, mean log loss nonworse; positive gate still requires E1-B confirmation

classification: catastrophe (valid decline >10% of absolute parent fitness)
auxiliary_targets.regression: positive gain / abs(parent fitness), Ridge(alpha=1), expanding window and refit=10, clip predictions at zero
auxiliary_targets.role: secondary only; no tuning or change to primary gate
